profile.headline: Software Engineer at CACI International Inc
profile.summary: AI and web developer in the world of defense contracting.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed client-facing geospatial applications with a focus on modern UX/UI using TypeScript, Svelte, and Spring Boot.

Led the intern program for two years, mentoring junior developers and coordinating onboarding and project delivery.

Implemented Agile and DevSecOps workflows, including Jira-based project tracking, automated testing with Vitest and Cypress, and CI/CD practices.

Specialist in SVG design, custom iconography, and advanced 3D rendering using OpenSphere with Bedrock AI workflow integration.

Complex geospatial data visualization and analysis.

ServiceNow Senior Developer
positions.insights: Skills: UI · WebSocket · User Experience (UX) · Spring Boot · Svelte · Confluence · Jenkins · Node.js · Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG)

positions.title: Captain – Intelligence Officer / Platoon Leader
positions.description:
Led S2 Intelligence Section, developing foreign intelligence reports and security assessments to support operational planning.

Served as Security Officer and Counterterrorism Officer during deployment to Baden-Württemberg, Germany with the 52d Signal Battalion.

Directed intelligence operations, personnel security programs, and information protection measures across multiple units.

Managed and mentored teams responsible for intelligence analysis and force protection in domestic and overseas environments.

positions.title: Security Officer / S2
positions.description:
ADOS Position with the 52d Signal BN.
S2, Security Officer, Counterterrorism Officer.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
ServiceNow Certified Developer and ITSM subject matter expert, responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing ITSM processes to support major defense contracts, including Raytheon, CACI, and Lockheed Martin.

Developed custom ServiceNow applications and workflows using JavaScript, implemented Single Sign-On (SSO), and built robust roles and group access controls to secure sensitive data and ensure compliance.

Built and maintained full-stack solutions leveraging the MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular.js, Node.js), AWS services, and Agile methodologies.

Authored Bash scripts and contributed to enterprise Java development to support platform integrations and automation.
positions.insights: Skills: Apache · User Experience (UX) · ServiceNow Administration · ServiceNow · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG)

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
Designed and developed multiple applications with a focus on machine learning, natural language processing, and web technologies.

Created Phonetic Frog, an NLP-based phoneme and viseme mapping app published on the Google Play Store.

Built machine learning applications for image recognition and detection using Python, TensorFlow, and MATLAB, with TensorFlow.js powering interactive web front ends.

Developed and deployed various web apps and AI solutions for language processing and computer vision use cases.
positions.insights: Skills: TensorFlow · Python (Programming Language) · MATLAB · TensorFlow.js · Node.js · Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) · JavaScript · Android · Web Development

positions.title: Applications Analyst
positions.locationName: Parkersburg, West Virginia, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Wrote, produced, and delivered training content—including videos and user manuals—to onboard staff to Meditech and LSS electronic medical record (EMR) platforms, using Camtasia and HTML-based guides.

Designed and developed a mobile-friendly HTML resource site and SharePoint-based portals for training materials and performance reporting.

Led the implementation of a hospital-wide patient survey system (NRC Connect), improving data collection for quality initiatives.

Conducted IT security audits and created compliance documentation to support meaningful use and legal obligations under ACA and NQF requirements.

Taught clinicians and staff best practices for electronic records and performance measures.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · jQuery Mobile · Web Development

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
Maintained and deployed Windows-based servers, network infrastructure, and remote access solutions across multiple field sites.

Migrated all employee email accounts from physical servers to cloud-based platforms.

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Volunteered at St. Michael's Hospital in Pramso, Ghana
- Assisted in managing inoculations, HIV/AIDS clinic operations, & outreach programs for 400+ patients/day
- Assisted and performed both surgical and nonsurgical child births as well as hernia surgery

- Orphanage volunteer in Villa Allende, Argentina.
- Provided care and regular feeding for children with severe mental and physical disabilities.
